blueprint_completion.ui_unavailable: The native build tool is unavailable or is not ready for existing blueprint completion.
blueprint_completion.ui_busy: The native build UI is busy; existing blueprint completion was not committed.
blueprint_completion.pause_required: Pause the game before completing an existing blueprint.
blueprint_completion.preview_unavailable: The native build tool did not expose the exact requested preview; no build gesture was issued.
blueprint_completion.native_failed: The native existing blueprint completion entry point failed; inspect the observed result before retrying.
blueprint_completion.cleanup_failed: The native build tool could not be verified as restored to the selection tool.
blueprint_completion.target_changed: The exact blueprint or game context changed; existing blueprint completion was refused.
blueprint_completion.target_unverifiable: The exact existing blueprint identity or construction choices could not be verified.
blueprint_completion.definition_unavaila: Native existing blueprint completion is currently available only for Tile blueprints.
blueprint_completion.material_unverifiab: Existing blueprint completion requires one known construction material; multiple materials are outside this verification scope.
blueprint_completion.facade_unverifiable: The existing blueprint facade could not be verified; no native completion gesture was issued.
blueprint_completion.safety_blocked: Existing blueprint completion was refused because its footprint, protected terrain, vegetation, backwall or connection endpoints are unsafe or unknown.
blueprint_completion.world_inactive: Existing blueprint completion requires its world to be the active world.
blueprint_completion.observation_unavail: The result of existing blueprint completion could not be verified; changed and applied values remain unknown.
blueprint_completion.completion_not_obse: No verified completion of the exact existing blueprint was observed; the native void entry point provides no refusal reason.
blueprint_completion.protected_state_cha: The inspected footprint no longer matches the protected occupants expected after native completion; no retry or restoration was attempted.
